title: Starlight Warp
blurb: Warp through hyperspace: ring tunnels, orbiting moons, warp gates and a black hole.

levels.name: Warp Tunnel
levels.intro: Into hyperspace. Hit the eight orange pegs on the turning rings.

levels.name: Comet Tail
levels.intro: A great comet sweeps across the stars. Break fifty pegs.

levels.name: Twinkle Field
levels.intro: New: thieves steal a saved power, or points. Make a chain of eighteen in one shot.

levels.name: Binary Stars
levels.intro: Two stars turn against each other. Hit the six orange pegs on their points.

levels.name: Warp Gates
levels.intro: New: portals warp your ball to their twin. Reach the gems sealed in the pods. Five gems.

levels.name: Moon Dance
levels.intro: New: spikes pop your ball. Collect the six gem moons, but dodge the spiked ones.

levels.name: Spiral Galaxy
levels.intro: The galaxy wheels round its core. Break forty five pegs.

levels.name: Asteroid Belt
levels.intro: A river of rocks drifts past. Break every rock in the belt.

levels.name: Nebula
levels.intro: New: sticky gas slows your ball right down. Reach twenty thousand points.

levels.name: Pulsar
levels.intro: Twin beams sweep from the pulsar. Hit every orange peg, ten in all.

levels.name: Constellations
levels.intro: The night sky turns. Light all seven lanterns among the stars.

levels.name: Ringed Giant
levels.intro: Moons race round the ringed giant. Collect all five gems.

levels.name: Hyperjump
levels.intro: Stars stream past at light speed. Make a chain of twenty four in one shot.

levels.name: Gravity Well
levels.intro: New: black holes pull your ball in and swallow it. Hit the ten orange pegs.

levels.name: Meteor Shower
levels.intro: New: shrinkers make your ball tiny for a shot. Break twenty eight pegs.

levels.name: Orrery
levels.intro: Planets circle the sun on their tracks. Collect the five gem planets.

levels.name: Supernova
levels.intro: A dying star breathes in and out. Break every brick, armour too. Blasts and lightning help.

levels.name: Star Gate
levels.intro: Keys circle the gate. Open it and hit every orange peg, twelve in all.

levels.name: Lightspeed
levels.intro: The hexagons whirl ever faster. Hit the nine orange pegs.

levels.name: Warp Core
levels.intro: The warp core burns behind its turning shield. Hit all ten orange pegs.
